Bransys ELD older versions are vulnerable to hardcoded credentials and plaintext transmission flaws, which could lead to data breaches.

## Key points
*   Android versions below 11.00.00 and iOS versions below 1.1.54 are affected.
*   Attackers can read real-time telemetry data and firmware using hardcoded credentials.
*   Transmission of sensitive information in plaintext allows hackers to connect via proxies and steal data.

## What to do next
*   Immediately check the system versions on fleet devices and upgrade them to secure versions as soon as possible.
*   Isolate industrial control system networks and prevent direct exposure to the internet.
